content_sections.body: Prepare a two-turn exchange about asking for help at a ticket machine. Give the main detail, listen to one follow-up, and answer it clearly. Use this model as support: 'My card did not work at the machine, so I asked a staff member for help.' The exchange should meet this lesson goal: Understand and produce a short, polite service exchange.
content_sections.title: Use it in a practical exchange (8 minutes)

content_sections.body: Partner A begins a realistic exchange about asking for help at a ticket machine. Partner B asks for one missing detail. Swap roles and make one change to the time, place, reason, quantity, or next action. Check that the exchange achieves: Understand and produce a short, polite service exchange.
content_sections.title: Guided dialogue (8 minutes)

content_sections.body: Create a short message about asking for help at a ticket machine without reading the model. Include a main event or plan and one precise detail. Speak it once slowly, then once at a natural pace. Listen for whether the key information is clear.
